name: Kanto in First Person - Interiors and Tweaks
description: Companion patch for the Dramatic Shape Voxel Mod that finishes Kanto's first-person view. Interiors and caves gain real walls, a ceiling with headroom, and proper doors (including the two-cell double doors), all textured from each room's own art so a cave looks like rock and a Mart looks like a Mart. Outdoors, a painted horizon wraps the world so the map no longer ends in empty sky. Ledge hops get weight, with a crouch, a boosted arc and a landing settle. In the diorama rungs, an optional Sims-style cutaway melts the near walls as you walk. Everything is presentational: no collision, movement, scripts or saves are touched. Installs itself into Dramatic Shape, survives its updates, and backs out cleanly.
